results: Normal starts with only two occupied toilets and four kinds of patrols
Real walking contact starts a visible countdown and blocks keyboard, click and E escape
Reload during a conversation preserves its countdown; pause consumes neither clock
Conversation fits a phone viewport and releases the player after listening
Sustained real sprint input exhausts stamina and walking time restores it
A previously empty stall returns to cleaning and then opens again
No JavaScript exceptions or external requests
